findings.what: Form remounts via key=JSON.stringify(values) after each submit; keyboard focus is lost after a failed validation, focus is not moved to the first invalid field, and per-field errors are not in a live region, so screen readers don't announce them
Public unauthenticated server action writes to DB with no rate limiting or spam protection; contact_messages can be flooded
SQLite file at cwd/data/app.db is created at runtime (breaks on read-only/serverless hosts) and relies on node:sqlite with no engines pin in package.json
Length limits use String.length (UTF-16 code units), so emoji count double; SQLite does not enforce VARCHAR(n), so the DB layer doesn't back up these limits
